summary: Iteration 14 — four-pillar condition rating overhaul verified end-to-end. BACKEND (new /app/backend/tests/test_four_pillars.py): 26/26 PASS in 3.01s covering (a) all four pillars required→422 when any missing, (b) exterior/tyre optional and legacy-client happy path, (c) persisted doc has all four pillars + legacy `condition` alias == round((m+c+i+h)/4) (verified 8+5+9+3=6 and 10*4=10 and 7*4=7), (d) GET /api/submissions/{id} echoes the four pillars, (e) bogus values 0/-1/11/100/'foo' all 422, (f) regression sweep — /api/admin/submissions with all three bucket filters + /api/admin/billing + /api/dealer/photos all still 200, (g) LEGACY submissions (18 in DB with exterior_condition set + mechanical_condition null) still fetch cleanly via GET with no _id leak. Regression pytest for test_dealer_photos.py (fixed a stale payload line — added 3 pillars) + test_silo_buckets.py + test_archive_dealers.py = 40/40 PASS. FRONTEND mobile 390x844 (dealer minitest@example.com/Mini1234!): CONDITION section renders EXACTLY four rating rows in top-to-bottom order (Mechanical Health y=960 → Cosmetic Appearance y=1046 → Interior Condition y=1132 → History / Maintenance y=1218) with hint 'Four pillars. The overall condition rating is the average of these.' visible above them; 4 'Not rated' badges default; tapping rating-3 (nth 0) turned dots 1-3 RED (computed rgb(192,57,43)), badge = '3/10 · Poor'; rating-5 (nth 1) turned 5 dots YELLOW rgb(212,172,13) badge '5/10 · Fair'; rating-8 (nth 2) turned 8 dots GREEN rgb(39,174,96) badge '8/10 · Good'. Windscreen field hint still reads 'Choose windscreen condition'. Validation strings for all four pillars are present in submit.tsx:219-222 ('Please rate the mechanical health.' / 'Please rate the cosmetic appearance.' / 'Please rate the interior condition.' / 'Please rate the history / maintenance.'). E2E happy path: dealer POST /api/submissions with mech=8/cosm=5/int=9/hist=3 → HTTP 200, reference FB-000041, stored pillars 8/5/9/3, legacy `condition` alias = 6 (round(6.25)). Admin mobile /vehicle/[id] (390x844) for FB-000041: hero card shows '6.3 / 10' (JS toFixed(1) rounds 6.25→'6.3'), four HeroPills MECH 8/10 / COSM 5/10 / INT 9/10 / HIST 3/10, zero legacy EXT/TYRES pills; DetailRow list contains all 7 expected labels (Mechanical Health:, Cosmetic Appearance:, Interior Condition:, History / Maintenance:, Windscreen:, Previous Accident Damage:, Paint Evidence:). Admin desktop cockpit 1440x900 same submission: identical result — '6.3 / 10' hero + 4 pills MECH/COSM/INT/HIST + 7 DetailRow labels rendered under the Condition group. Regression: legacy sub FB-000031 (ext=8/int=7/tyre=8, no pillars) on mobile /vehicle/[id] falls back correctly — hero pills read EXT / INT / TYRES (0 occurrences of MECH/COSM/HIST), overall condition '7.0 / 10', windscreen/accident/paint rows still render. Legacy cockpit path exercises the same `typeof mechanical_condition === 'number'` guard so behaviour is identical by construction. NO regressions introduced.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Four-pillar rewrite is COMPLETE and verified. Key facts: (1) rating-N testIDs now render 4× per page (one row per pillar), use .nth(0)=Mechanical, .nth(1)=Cosmetic, .nth(2)=Interior, .nth(3)=History. (2) DOM labels appear with a trailing colon (e.g. 'Mechanical Health:') so exact-text selectors need `contains` or you need to walk innerText. (3) Backend still exposes legacy `condition` (single int, rounded avg) alongside the four pillars — many old admin/analytics queries rely on this. (4) 18 legacy submissions in DB (mech_condition==null, ext_condition set) — cockpit + mobile detail both drop back to EXT/INT/TYRES hero pills and Exterior/Interior/Tyres DetailRows automatically. (5) test_phase3.py has stale fixtures pre-dating the entire progressive-filter schema — ignore or refactor, not this iteration's regression. (6) JS toFixed(1) on 6.25 renders '6.3' in browsers (round-half-away-from-zero at that precision) — matches spec.
